articles.summary: On 29 July 2026, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and Philippine Payments Management, Inc. launched InstaPay for Business, allowing eligible business and corporate accounts to send up to PHP 500,000 per transaction through participating institutions. The service does not impose a scheme-level limit on the number of transactions or aggregate daily value, although originating institutions may apply their own limits.
